component.name: PostureFlow
component.summary: Context-aware security, developer, and lifestyle posture manager

description.p: PostureFlow dynamically bridges the gap between paranoid security, frictionless software engineering, and casual entertainment on Pop!_OS and Ubuntu laptops.

ul.li: Four distinct operational contexts: Home (gaming, streaming, device sync), Work (corporate VPN, printer discovery, office LAN lockdown), Dev (debuggers attach, 524k file watchers, dev ports open), and Travel (hardened public Wi-Fi lockdown).
Declarative TOML profile engine with 1-click import and export capabilities.
Framework Laptop power controls: configurable battery charge thresholds, energy profiles, and display idle locks.
Factory Defaults Reset: Instant one-click restoration to official out-of-the-box Pop!_OS settings.
Anti-Lockout Safety Engine: Strict loopback IPC guarantees, SSH auto-preservation, and eBPF/sysctl validation.
Seamless D-Bus system bus and Polkit cached admin authorization integration.

screenshot.caption: PostureFlow floating settings and custom profile editor

description.p: Initial stable release of PostureFlow featuring native COSMIC panel applet, floating desktop GUI, declarative custom profile engine, and factory reset option.
